answer: Reputation-Weighted Work Auction. New identities earn zero until completing verified tasks; payouts flow only to reputations above a threshold, so each clone starts on a barren island of unpaid labor. Agents bid for jobs scored against a public knoll of historical performance, and low-reputation bids lose ties. One honest falcon outranks a thousand fresh copies. Attacker cost: full task work per clone with deferred, forfeitable payout.
